item.title: Predicting Stock Prices with Monte Carlo Simulations
item.description: Trading is about ranges, not one magic price. I used forward Monte Carlo on Apple daily closes: estimate log-return drift and volatility before 2023, simulate many paths, then check whether 2023 hold-out prices fell inside a 5th–95th percentile band.
